decision_reason: Restores punctuation-insensitive entity matching across unseen labels, preserves all deterministic public forecasts, passes 11/11 smoke, and keeps every affected official two-model NLI unit at or above the 0.80 gate.
decision_rule: Require 13/13 synthetic top-1, token preservation tests, unchanged public predictions and smoke; rerun official NLI for every public unit with a changed top-three retrieval set.
hypothesis: Removing sentence-edge punctuation from lexical tokens restores exact entity and keyword matches without damaging financial numeric tokens.

official_nli.runtime_caveat: Local Intel CPU and installed packages approximate but do not certify production runtime equivalence.
